body.statement: Under consistency and conditional exchangeability, \(\Psi(P)=E_P[K_X\otimes\{L_{Y(1)}-L_{Y(0)}\}]\). On the two-outcome submodel supported on \(\{y_-,y_+\}\), this becomes \(\Psi(P)=E_P[K_X\otimes b_Y\{P(Y=y_+\mid A=1,X)-P(Y=y_+\mid A=0,X)\}]\).
body.justification: This fixes the law-valued causal target while supplying a legal two-outcome reduction for the lower-bound construction.
body.gap: Jain and Luedtke give the general identifying moment; the embedded two-outcome reduction is needed here to audit exact-null mixtures and source membership without shrinking the ambient model to CATE.
body.consumer: The reduction makes the least-favorable experiment computable while the resulting frontier continues to govern general conditional outcome laws.
